title: A new era of economic measurement for the environment and natural capital
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: In January 2023, the US federal government finalized a national strategy to develop natural capital accounts and associated environmental-economic statistics. Implementing natural capital accounts and environmental-economic statistics is the logical next step in the evolution of national economic statistics and is possible because of new technology, methods, and political will. Natural capital accounts and environmental-economic statistics will require engagement by the research community, because there is still substantial work to do. They will also open new avenues for research. Here, I provide a brief description of the US national strategy to develop natural capital accounts and associated environmental economic statistics, offer the context for this national strategy, discuss some potential uses, and identify potential areas where new research is likely needed.
abstract_zh: 环境与自然资本经济计量的新纪元。2023年1月，美国联邦政府最终确定了发展自然资本账户及相关环境经济统计的国家战略。实施自然资本账户和环境经济统计，是国民经济统计演进的合乎逻辑的下一步，这得益于新技术、新方法和政治意愿。自然资本账户和环境经济统计需要研究界的参与，因为仍有大量工作有待完成。它们也将开辟新的研究方向。在此，我简要介绍美国发展自然资本账户及相关环境经济统计的国家战略，提供该国家战略的背景，讨论一些潜在用途，并指出可能需要新研究的潜在领域。

title: Mainstreaming nature in the U.S. public policy
The path to scientifically sound biodiversity valuation in the context of the global biodiversity framework
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 121(34) e2319077121
abstract: Successful implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework requires identifying a process for measuring and valuing changes in biodiversity that build on the recognition that economics and valuation must play a key role in “halting and reversing” biodiversity loss. Here, we discuss considerations for a practical path to valuing changes in biodiversity. Framing changes in the value of biodiversity as a summary of changes in certain natural assets enables leveraging existing approaches and international standards associated with environmental-economic accounting. We discuss why an approach that builds from individual species, evolutionary groups, or functional groups into a practical, hierarchical statistical classification system is better than the development of any one biodiversity index. We merge techniques from ecology and other natural sciences, national and environmental-economic accounting, and economics, which are all on the cusp of making measurement of the change in the value of biodiversity possible. The focus should be on scaling and integrating these approaches. The path forward appears to begin with imperfect but useful measures, grounded in robust concepts, while establishing ambition to further scale-up measurements—just like the past evolution of many other official statistical series.
abstract_zh: 在全球生物多样性框架背景下实现科学可靠的生物多样性价值评估之路。《昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》的有效实施，要求确定一个衡量和评估生物多样性变化的过程。该过程建立在这样一个认识之上：经济学和价值评估必须在“遏制并扭转”生物多样性丧失中发挥关键作用。在此，我们讨论了实际评估生物多样性变化的若干考虑因素。将生物多样性价值的变化界定为某些自然资产变化的汇总，有助于利用与环境经济核算相关的既有方法和国际标准。我们讨论了为什么从单个物种、进化类群或功能群出发，构建实用的分层统计分类体系，比开发任何单一的生物多样性指数更为可取。我们融合了生态学及其他自然科学、国民与环境经济核算以及经济学的技术，这些领域都正处于使生物多样性价值变化的测量成为可能的边缘。重点应放在扩大和整合这些方法上。前进的道路似乎应从不完美但有用的测度开始，这些测度以稳健的概念为基础，同时确立进一步扩大测量规模的目标，正如许多其他官方统计序列过去的演变历程一样。

The effects of moose browsing on balsam fir and forest recovery vary with bioclimatic and human use across the island of Newfoundland
abstract: Moose present a complex management problem because they generate a mixture of benefits and costs to humans, some of which are caused by browsing of regenerating trees. We developed a Lotka–Volterra model, parameterized by moose management areas, to link moose browsing to spruce and balsam fir dynamics on the island of Newfoundland. The model predicts the distribution of moose, adult fir, and spruce well. Empirical estimates of juvenile fir biomass were variable, and our model predicted its biomass poorly. Our model predicts a small negative effect of moose on adult fir biomass (−0.06%) and juvenile fir biomass (−1.65%) and a small positive effect on spruce biomass (+0.02%) under baseline assumptions, but larger effects (±10%–60%) if moose browse commercial softwoods preferentially. Small effects of moose on trees at steady state do not fully reflect the importance of moose because moose parameters (e.g., growth rate and harvesting rate) impacted the return time of our model from disturbance. Our model analysis demonstrates one way to add animal effects into vegetation growth models and suggests that parameterizing ecological models by management unit is useful when the data to support more detailed models are not available.
abstract_zh: 驼鹿啃食对香脂冷杉和森林恢复的影响因生物气候与人为因素而异。驼鹿带来的管理问题十分复杂，因为它们给人类带来的既有益处也有成本，其中部分成本源于对再生树木的啃食。我们建立了一个以驼鹿管理区为参数的Lotka–Volterra模型，用以联系纽芬兰岛上驼鹿的啃食与云杉和香脂冷杉的动态。该模型较好地预测了驼鹿、成年冷杉和云杉的分布。对幼年冷杉生物量的经验估计存在较大差异，我们的模型对其生物量的预测效果较差。在基准假设下，我们的模型预测驼鹿对成年冷杉生物量（−0.06%）和幼年冷杉生物量（−1.65%）产生小幅负面影响，对云杉生物量（+0.02%）产生小幅正面影响；但如果驼鹿优先啃食商业软木，则影响会更大（±10%–60%）。驼鹿在稳态下对树木的影响较小，并不能充分反映驼鹿的重要性，因为驼鹿参数（例如增长率和捕获率）影响了模型从干扰中恢复的时间。我们的模型分析展示了将动物效应纳入植被生长模型的一种方法，并表明在缺乏支持更详细模型的数据时，按管理单元对生态模型进行参数化是有用的。

title: Fish and fisheries in hot water: what is happening and how do we adapt?
abstract: Rapid climate changes are currently driving substantial reorganizations of marine ecosystems around the world. A key question is how these changes will alter the provision of ecosystem services from the ocean, particularly from fisheries. To answer this question, we need to understand not only the ecological dynamics of marine systems, but also human adaptation and feedbacks between humans and the rest of the natural world. In this review, we outline what we have learned from research primarily in continental shelf ecosystems and fishing communities of North America. Key findings are that marine animals are highly sensitive to warming and are responding quickly to changes in water temperature, and that such changes are often happening faster than similar processes on land. Changes in species distributions and productivity are having substantial impacts on fisheries, including through changing catch compositions and longer distances traveled for fishing trips. Conflicts over access to fisheries have also emerged as species distributions are no longer aligned with regulations or catch allocations. These changes in the coupled natural‐human system have reduced the value of ecosystem services from some fisheries and risk doing so even more in the future. Going forward, substantial opportunities for more effective fisheries management and operations, marine conservation, and marine spatial planning are likely possible through greater consideration of climate information over time‐scales from years to decades.
abstract_zh: 暖水中的鱼类与渔业：正在发生什么，我们如何适应。快速的气候变化正在驱动全球海洋生态系统的大规模重组。一个关键问题是，这些变化将如何改变海洋生态系统服务的供给，特别是渔业服务。要回答这一问题，我们不仅需要理解海洋系统的生态动态，还需要理解人类适应以及人类与自然世界其他部分之间的反馈。在本综述中，我们概述了主要基于北美大陆架生态系统和渔业社区研究所获得的认识。主要发现是：海洋动物对变暖高度敏感，并迅速响应水温变化，而且这种变化往往比陆地上的类似过程发生得更快。物种分布和生产力的变化正在对渔业产生重大影响，包括捕捞组成的改变，以及渔业作业航程的延长。随着物种分布不再与管理规定或渔获配额保持一致，围绕渔业准入的冲突也已出现。这些耦合的自然—人类系统的变化，已降低了部分渔业所提供生态系统服务的价值，并且未来可能进一步加剧这一风险。展望未来，通过更多地考虑从数年到数十年时间尺度上的气候信息，可能为提升渔业管理与运营效率、海洋保护以及海洋空间规划带来大量机遇。

title: For want of a chair: Teaching price formation using a cap and trade game
abstract: The tradable or transferable permit system, “cap and trade”, is one of the most innovative policy options developed by environmental economists. Over the last 40 years, cap and trade programs have been used around the globe by some of the world’s biggest economies. By placing a cap on a bad, whether a pollutant or excess fish mortality, and then allowing firms to buy and sell the right to generate it, policy makers combine government intervention with market-based incentives in order to improve welfare and internalize the externality. Such programs represent a great opportunity for economics instructors to show students how economic theory can be used in the real world by policy makers while teaching foundational economic concepts. By using an in-class game that utilizes a mobile app or paper-based interaction to create a market for a pollutant (or another rival but non-excludable resource), students can learn several important tenants of economics. These include how prices are formed and how price-based incentives lead to voluntary, as if cooperative, behavior by agents. This active learning method engages students while improving their comprehension of price formation, gains from trade, voluntary response to incentives, and an important environmental economics policy.
abstract_zh: 缺少讲席（for want of a chair）：用总量控制与交易博弈教授价格形成。可转让或可交易的许可制度，即“总量控制与交易”，是环境经济学家开发的最具创新性的政策选择之一。在过去40年中，总量控制与交易计划已在全球范围内被世界上一些最大的经济体所采用。通过对某种“坏东西”（无论是污染物还是过度的鱼类死亡）设定总量上限，然后允许企业买卖产生该“坏东西”的权利，政策制定者将政府干预与市场化激励相结合，以提高福利并使外部性内部化。此类计划为经济学教师提供了一个良好机会，向学生展示经济理论如何被政策制定者应用于现实世界，同时讲授基础经济学概念。通过使用一种课堂博弈，借助移动应用程序或纸质互动来为某种污染物（或另一种有竞争性但非排他性的资源）创建市场，学生可以学到经济学的几项重要原则。这些原则包括价格如何形成，以及基于价格的激励如何引导各主体做出自愿的、仿佛合作般的行为。这种主动学习方法在提升学生对价格形成、贸易收益、对激励的自愿反应以及一项重要环境经济政策的理解的同时，也能激发学生的学习兴趣。

title: Preparing for a changing future in recreational fisheries: 100 research questions for global consideration emerging from a horizon scan
venue: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries 30:137-151
abstract: Recreational fisheries hold immense ecological, social, and economic value. The management of these fisheries is increasingly important as we move forward in the Anthropocene. Recreational fisheries managers face several challenges as fisheries often involve diverse social and ecological systems comprised of complex feedback and stakeholder motivations and needs. Here, we used a horizon scanning exercise to yield 100 research questions related to recreational fisheries science and management in the Anthropocene. Initial research questions ( n = 205) were collected from recreational fisheries experts (i.e., stakeholders, managers, researchers) from various sectors (i.e., industry, government, NGOs) and geographic locations (14 countries: Australia, Brazil, Canada, Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, New Zealand, Norway, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, USA). These questions were subsequently categorized, thematized, and refined by our authorship team, eventually yielding what we considered to be the top 100 research questions of relevance to management of recreational fisheries. The key themes include: human dimensions; bioeconomics; resource monitoring and data acquisition; governance; management—regulatory actions; management—stock and habitat enhancement; catch-and-release; impacts of recreational fisheries on populations, communities and ecosystems; threats and sustainability; and angler outreach, education and engagement. It is our intention that this comprehensive and forward-looking list will create a framework to guide future research within this field, and contribute to evidence-based recreational fisheries management and policy.
abstract_zh: 为休闲渔业变化中的未来做准备：全球变化下的100个研究问题。休闲渔业具有巨大的生态、社会和经济价值。随着我们迈入人类世，此类渔业的管理日益重要。休闲渔业管理者面临诸多挑战，因为渔业往往涉及多样化的社会和生态系统，其中包含复杂的反馈机制以及各利益相关方的动机与需求。在此，我们采用视野扫描（horizon scanning）的方法，提出了100个与人类世背景下休闲渔业科学与管理相关的研究问题。初始研究问题（n = 205）征集自来自不同部门（即产业界、政府、非政府组织）和地理位置（14个国家：澳大利亚、巴西、加拿大、捷克、德国、意大利、新西兰、挪威、南非、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士、英国和美国）的休闲渔业专家（即利益相关者、管理者、研究人员）。这些问题随后由我们的作者团队进行分类、主题归纳和精炼，最终形成了我们认为与休闲渔业管理最相关的100个研究问题。主要主题包括：人的维度；生物经济学；资源监测与数据获取；治理；管理——监管行动；管理——种群与栖息地增殖；捕放；休闲渔业对种群、群落和生态系统的影响；威胁与可持续性；以及垂钓者推广、教育与参与。我们希望这一全面且具有前瞻性的清单能够构建一个框架，指导该领域未来的研究，并为基于证据的休闲渔业管理和政策做出贡献。

title: The Economics of "Conservation Debt": A Natural Capital Approach to Revealed Valuation of Ecological Dynamics
abstract: Some species are valued for their direct usefulness to society, through immediate financial returns from market activities such as harvesting or ecotourism. But many are valued for their passive usefulness, i.e., their mere existence contributes to supporting, regulating or cultural environmental services that support human well‐being. Hence, there is inherent social value to conserving such species as natural assets. However, such species are seldom priced as natural assets, and thus not accounted for in sustainability wealth measures because deriving non‐market prices is challenging. We overcome this limitation by presenting a new approach for natural asset pricing of species with passive value that can be incorporated into national sustainability wealth accounting. We explicitly consider the relationship between prevailing institutions, species interactions, and ecosystem dynamics. Our approach is illustrated with the case of threatened woodland caribou in the Alberta Oil Sands. We show that conservation can be considered an investment while destructive activities can lead to a loss or conservation debt; and forgoing destructive activities can be considered a capital gain, increasing future wealth. Our approach reveals that caribou conservation in Alberta is leading to a conservation debt on the order of CA$800 million.
abstract_zh: 保护债务的经济学：一种揭示生态系统价值的自然资本方法。一些物种因其对社会的直接用途而受到重视，例如通过采伐或生态旅游等市场活动获得即时经济回报。但许多物种的价值在于其被动用途，即其单纯存在有助于支撑、调节或文化性的环境服务，从而促进人类福祉。因此，保护此类物种作为自然资产本身具有内在的社会价值。然而，此类物种很少被作为自然资产定价，因此未被纳入可持续财富测度，因为推导非市场价格具有挑战性。我们通过提出一种针对具有被动价值物种的自然资产定价新方法，克服了这一局限，该方法可纳入国家可持续财富核算。我们明确考虑了既有制度、物种相互作用与生态系统动态之间的关系。我们以阿尔伯塔油砂中濒危的林地驯鹿为例说明了该方法。我们表明，保护可以被视为一种投资，而破坏性活动可能导致损失或保护债务；放弃破坏性活动则可被视为资本收益，从而增加未来财富。我们的方法显示，阿尔伯塔对驯鹿的保护正导致约8亿加元量级的保护债务。

Synchronized peak rate years of global resources use imply critical trade-offs in appropriation of natural resources and ecosystem services
venue: In Atlas of Ecosystem Services, Springer, 301-307 (book chapter)
abstract: Many separate studies have estimated the year of peak, or maximum, rate of using an individual resource such as oil. However, no study has estimated the year of peak rate for multiple resources and investigated the relationships among them. We exploit time series on the appropriation of 27 global renewable and nonrenewable resources. We found 21 resources experienced a peak-rate year, and for 20 resources the peak-rate years occurred between 1960-2010, a narrow time window in the long human history. Whereas 4 of 7 nonrenewable resources show no peak-rate year, conversion to cropland and 18 of the 20 renewable resources have passed their peak rate of appropriation. To test the hypothesis that peak-rate years are synchronized, i.e., occur at approximately the same time, we analyzed 20 statistically independent time series of resources, of which 16 presented a peak-rate year centered on 2006 (1989-2008).We discuss potential causal mechanisms including change in demand, innovation and adaptation, interdependent use of resources, physical limitation, and simultaneous scarcity. The synchrony of peak-rate years of multiple resources poses a greater adaptation challenge for society than previously recognized, suggesting the need for a paradigm shift in resource use toward a sustainable path in the Anthropocene.
abstract_zh: 全球资源利用的同步峰值年份意味着占用中的关键权衡。许多独立研究估计了单一资源（如石油）使用速率达到峰值或最大值的年份。然而，尚无研究估计多种资源的峰值速率年份，并考察它们之间的关系。我们利用27种全球可再生和不可再生资源占用的时间序列数据。我们发现，21种资源经历过峰值速率年份，其中20种资源的峰值速率年份出现在1960至2010年之间，这一时间窗口在漫长的人类历史中十分狭窄。在7种不可再生资源中，有4种未出现峰值速率年份，而转为耕地的用途以及20种可再生资源中的18种，已经越过了其占用速率的峰值。为检验峰值速率年份同步的假设（即大致在同一时间出现），我们分析了20个统计上独立的资源时间序列，其中16个的峰值速率年份集中在2006年前后（1989至2008年）。我们讨论了潜在的因果机制，包括需求变化、创新与适应、资源的相互依赖使用、物理限制以及同步稀缺。多种资源峰值年份的同步，对社会构成了比此前认识到的更大的适应挑战，这表明需要在资源利用上进行范式转变，走向人类世中的可持续发展道路。

abstract: The natural capital concept is generating broad interest that extends well beyond economists. Economics has a long history of applying capital theory to natural resources. However, measurement of the value of ecosystems has mostly focused on income flows rather than valuing stocks of natural assets. While, the two concepts are interconnected, measuring the value of natural capital is important for improving social benefit-cost analysis and to allow nature to be more fully included in sustainability-focused wealth accounts. Typical bookend assumptions of the social planner optimally managing natural capital versus open access driving its marginal value to zero are insufficient to capture the actual spectrum of imperfect institutions. This chapter develops theory and techniques for measuring natural capital shadow prices or asset values in real world situations.
abstract_zh: 自然资本与生态系统收入的本质。自然资本概念正引起广泛关注，其影响已远超经济学家的范围。经济学长期以来一直将资本理论应用于自然资源。然而，对生态系统价值的测度主要集中于收入流，而非对自然资产存量的估值。尽管二者相互关联，但衡量自然资本的价值对于改进社会成本收益分析，以及使自然更充分地纳入以可持续发展为导向的财富核算体系，具有重要意义。社会计划者最优管理自然资本与开放获取使其边际价值趋于零这两种典型的两端假设，不足以涵盖现实中不完善制度的实际谱系。本章发展了在现实世界情境中测度自然资本影子价格或资产价值的理论与技术。

title: Ecosystem based management and the wealth of ecosystems
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 114: 6539-6544
abstract: Ecosystems store vast quantities of wealth, but difficulties measuring wealth held in ecosystems prevent its inclusion in accounting systems. Ecosystem-based management endeavors to manage ecosystems holistically. However, ecosystem-based management lacks headline indicators to evaluate performance. We unify the inclusive wealth and ecosystem-based management paradigms, allowing apples-to-apples comparisons between the wealth of the ecosystem and other forms of wealth, while providing a headline performance index for evaluating the performance of ecosystem-based management. We project that the Baltic Sea fishery ecosystem yields increasing stores of wealth over the next 50 y under the ecosystem-based management-inspired multispecies maximum sustainable yield management beginning in 2017, whereas the previous single-species management generally results in declining wealth.
abstract_zh: 基于生态系统的管理与生态系统财富。生态系统蕴藏着巨大的财富，但测量生态系统中所蕴藏财富的困难，使其无法纳入核算体系。基于生态系统的管理致力于整体性地管理生态系统。然而，基于生态系统的管理缺乏用于评估绩效的总体指标。我们将包容性财富与基于生态系统的管理范式统一起来，使生态系统财富与其他形式的财富之间能够进行可比较的对照，同时提供了一个用于评估基于生态系统管理绩效的总体绩效指数。我们预测，在2017年开始实施的、受基于生态系统管理启发的多物种最大可持续产量管理之下，波罗的海渔业生态系统在未来50年内将产生不断增加的财富存量；而此前的单物种管理总体上会导致财富下降。

title: Measuring the value of groundwater and other forms of natural capital
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 113: 2382-2387
abstract: Economists have long argued, with recent acceptance from the science and policy community, that natural resources are capital assets. Pricing of natural capital has remained elusive, with the result that its value is often ignored, and expenditures on conservation are treated as costs rather than investments. This neglect stems from a lack of a valuation framework to enable apples to apples comparisons with traditional forms of capital. We develop such an approach and demonstrate it on Kansas’ groundwater stock. Between 1996 and 2005, groundwater withdrawal reduced Kansas’ wealth approximately $110 million per year. Wealth lost through groundwater depletion in Kansas is large, but in a range where offsetting investments may be feasible.
abstract_zh: 测量地下水及其他形式自然资本的价值。经济学家长期以来主张，自然资源是资本资产，科学界和政策界近来也已接受这一观点。然而，自然资本的定价仍然难以实现，其结果是其价值常被忽视，而对保护的支出被视为成本而非投资。这种忽视源于缺乏一个能够与传统资本形式进行同类可比较的估值框架。我们发展了这样一种方法，并以堪萨斯州的地下水存量为例加以说明。1996至2005年间，地下水抽取使堪萨斯州的财富每年减少约1.1亿美元。通过地下水枯竭造成的财富损失在堪萨斯州规模很大，但仍处于可能通过抵消性投资加以弥补的范围之内。

abstract: Fishery science and management are concerned with both positive, what happens in a fishery system, and normative, what management should do, questions. Rarely are normative criteria discussed as openly and transparently as the positive techniques and assumptions. Instead, normative criteria are often held implicitly, and often goals, and objectives are defined without careful thought about the normative criteria from which such goals, and objectives derive. Management involves three components: system attributes and dynamics, management options and goals and objectives that stem from normative criteria by which outcomes are judged. There is a need to consider normative frameworks and criteria carefully because normative criteria are intrinsic to any management process. This paper motivates the need to consider normative frameworks and criteria carefully, explores issues associated with developing normative frameworks and criteria that articulate positive science, discusses specific issues to consider when developing normative frameworks for recreational fisheries and provides the bioeconomic framework as an example of a normative framework useful for recreational fisheries.
abstract_zh: 休闲渔业管理的规范性考量：面向休闲渔业的生物经济框架。渔业科学与管理既关注实证问题（即渔业系统中会发生什么），也关注规范性问题（即管理应当做什么）。规范性标准很少像实证技术和假设那样被公开、透明地讨论。相反，规范性标准往往是隐含的，目标和指标的界定也常常缺乏对其所依据的规范性标准的审慎思考。管理包括三个组成部分：系统属性与动态、管理选项，以及据以判断结果的规范性标准所衍生出的目标和指标。有必要仔细考虑规范性框架和标准，因为规范性标准是任何管理过程所固有的。本文论证了仔细考虑规范性框架和标准的必要性，探讨了形成能够阐明实证科学的规范性框架和标准所涉及的问题，讨论了在为休闲渔业制定规范性框架时需要考虑的具体问题，并以生物经济框架作为适用于休闲渔业的规范性框架的范例。

title: The potential impact of labor choices on the efficacy of marine conservation strategies
abstract: Conservation of marine resources is critical to the wellbeing of human communities. Coastal artisanal fishing communities are particularly reliant on marine resources for food and for their livelihoods. Management actions aimed at marine conservation may lead to unanticipated changes in human behavior that influence the ability of conservation programs to achieve their goals. We examine how marine conservation strategies may impact labor decisions that influence both the ecosystem and human livelihoods using simulation modeling. We consider two conservation strategies in the model: direct action through fisheries regulation enforcement, and indirect action through land conservation. Our results indicate that both strategies can increase the abundance of fish, and thus contribute to the maintenance of marine resources. However, our results also show that marine fisheries enforcement may negatively impact the livelihoods of human communities. Land conservation, on the other hand, potentially enhances the livelihood of the human populations. Thus, depending on management objectives, indirect or a combination of direct and indirect conservation strategies may be effective at achieving conservation and sustainability goals. These results highlight the importance of accounting for changes in human behavior resulting from management actions in conservation and management.
abstract_zh: 劳动选择对海洋保护策略有效性的潜在影响。海洋资源的保护对人类社区的福祉至关重要。沿海小规模渔业社区在食物和生计上尤其依赖海洋资源。旨在保护海洋的管理行动可能导致人类行为发生意料之外的变化，从而影响保护项目实现其目标的能力。我们利用模拟建模，考察海洋保护策略如何影响劳动决策，而这些决策既影响生态系统，也影响人类生计。我们在模型中考虑了两种保护策略：通过渔业监管执法实施的直接行动，以及通过土地保护实施的间接行动。我们的结果表明，两种策略都可以增加鱼类丰度，从而有助于维持海洋资源。然而，我们的结果也表明，海洋渔业执法可能对人类社区的生计产生负面影响。另一方面，土地保护可能增进人类群体的生计。因此，根据管理目标的不同，间接保护策略或直接与间接保护策略相结合，可能是实现保护与可持续发展目标的有效途径。这些结果凸显了在保护与管理中，考虑管理行动所引起的人类行为变化的重要性。

Real Options for Precautionary Fisheries Management
abstract: The 1996 Food and Agriculture Organization’s (FAO) ‘Guidelines on the Precautionary Approach to Fisheries and Species Introduction’ raise important issues for fisheries managers, but fail to prescribe an approach for risk management. The distinguishing characteristics of the ‘precautionary approach’ are the inclusion of uncertainty and ‘an elaboration on the burden of proof’. The FAO precautionary approach emphasizes that managers should be risk‐averse, but does not provide tools for determining the appropriate degree of risk aversion. Consequently, application of the precautionary approach often leads to decision‐making based onad hocsafety margins. These safety margins are seldom chosen with explicit consideration of trade‐offs. If the emphasis was shifted to choosing between competing uncertainties, then managers could manage risk. By attempting to avoid risk, managers may gain exposure to other risks and perhaps miss valuable opportunities. We place fishery management problems within the rubric of ‘real investment’ problems, and compare and contrast the consideration of risk by alternative investment frameworks. We show that traditional investment frameworks are inappropriate for fishery management, and furthermore, that traditional precautionary approaches are arbitrary and without basis in decision theory. Quantitative decision‐making techniques, such as formal decision analysis (FDA), enable integration of competing hypotheses that help alleviate burden‐of‐proof issues. These techniques help analysts consider sources of uncertainty. FDA, however, can still be subject to arbitrary safety margins because such analyses often focus on determining which strategies best achieve, or avoid, targets that have been established without complete consideration of trade‐offs. A managerial finance approach, real options analysis (ROA), is an alternative and complementary decision‐making technique that enables managers to compute precautionary adjustments that couple the size of the ‘safety margin’ with the amount of uncertainty, thereby optimizing risk exposure and avoiding the need for arbitrary safety margins. We illustrate the advantages of an approach that combines FDA and ROA, using a heuristic example about a decision to re‐introduce Atlantic salmon (Salmo salarL.) into Lake Ontario. Finally, we provide guidance on applying ROA to other fishery problems. The precautionary approach requires that managers consider risk, but considering risk is not the same as managing it. Here ROA is useful.
abstract_zh: 1996年联合国粮农组织（FAO）的《渔业与物种引入预防性方法指南》对渔业管理者提出了重要问题，但并未规定风险管理的方法。“预防性方法”的显著特征在于纳入了不确定性，并“对举证责任作出阐述”。FAO的预防性方法强调管理者应当规避风险，但并未提供确定适当风险规避程度的工具。因此，预防性方法的应用往往导致基于临时性（ad hoc）安全边际的决策。这些安全边际很少在明确考虑权衡取舍的情况下选定。如果重点转向在相互竞争的不确定性之间进行选择，管理者便能够管理风险。一味试图规避风险，管理者可能会暴露于其他风险之中，也可能错失宝贵的机会。我们将渔业管理问题置于“实物投资”问题的框架之中，比较和对照了不同投资框架对风险的考量方式。我们表明，传统投资框架并不适用于渔业管理，而且传统的预防性方法是武断的，缺乏决策理论的依据。定量决策技术（如正式决策分析，FDA）能够整合相互竞争的假说，有助于缓解举证责任问题。这些技术有助于分析人员考虑不确定性的来源。然而，FDA仍可能受制于武断的安全边际，因为此类分析往往侧重于确定哪些策略最能实现或避免那些在未充分考虑权衡取舍的情况下设定的目标。管理财务方法，即实物期权分析（ROA），是一种替代且互补的决策技术，它使管理者能够计算预防性调整量，将“安全边际”的大小与不确定性的程度相匹配，从而优化风险暴露，并避免依赖武断的安全边际。我们以一项关于在安大略湖重新引入大西洋鲑（Salmo salar L.）的决策为启发式案例，说明结合FDA与ROA方法的优势。最后，我们就将ROA应用于其他渔业问题提供了指导。预防性方法要求管理者考虑风险，但考虑风险并不等同于管理风险。在这一点上，ROA是有用的。
